description:
Create a one-time Stripe Checkout link that adds prepaid credit to this AuditAE workspace. Nothing is charged by this call: give the returned url to the user, who opens it and pays by card. Credit lands within seconds of payment; call get_balance to confirm.

Billing: free — the user pays only if they complete the checkout. The link expires after 24 hours.

When to call: a paid tool returned out_of_credits, or get_balance shows too little for the run the user asked for. Suggest an amount that covers the planned work (prices are in each tool's description) and tell the user what it's for. For an agent workspace (no account behind it) the result also has claim_url: a link the user opens to sign up and take over the workspace.

Inputs:
  amount_cents — whole cents, 500–100000 ($5–$1000).

Example: { amount_cents: 2500 }
name: create_top_up_link
title: Create a Stripe checkout link to add AuditAE credit
